title: Implementation Plan — Session Caching
subtitle: Move session lookups off the hot path

blocks.x: We resolve the session on *every* request by hitting Postgres. This adds ~12ms p50. Plan: introduce a write-through cache in front of `SessionStore`.

items.title: Wire write-through in SessionStore
items.x: Populate on read-miss, invalidate on logout.

items.title: Load test + rollout
items.x: Shadow read for a day, then ramp.

blocks.title: Invalidation
blocks.x: The tricky part is logout — delete the cache key in the same transaction that revokes the session row, or you'll serve stale auth.

items: Stale sessions after logout if invalidation lags — mitigated by short TTL (60s).
Redis outage — fall back to direct `SessionStore` reads, never fail closed.
Cache stampede on cold start — use a per-key lock.
